user-sage.note: User Sage hosted MCP server for AI-assisted user testing: draft studies, recruit panels, read findings. Auth is per-user: set USERSAGE_API_KEY in your environment (a User Sage API key from Workspace settings > Integrations > MCP Connector) before starting Grok. MCP access requires a Pro workspace. If ${USERSAGE_API_KEY} is not expanded by your Grok client, register the server manually in your own Grok MCP config with the same URL and an Authorization: Bearer header carrying your key. See README.md.
